operations.GET /v1/sessions/{id}/chat: Saved session-only messages; no API key or network required

body.request_id: optional stable retry ID, 1..80 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens
body.search: optional boolean; explicit paid web search

POST /v1/sessions/{id}/chat.response: assistant message with content, provider, model, status, sources, links

operations.GET /v1/sessions/{id}/links: Session-only HTTPS references and supplied excerpts
operations.DELETE /v1/links/{id}: Delete reference and invalidate current handout

rules: Original recordings and attachments are not changed by chat
Chats stay on this device; there is no cloud sync
Course resource attachments are shared within their course; transcripts and links belong to one session
Generate notes or save a transcript before chatting about an audio-only session
Assistant history is dialogue, not evidence
Binary PDFs/photos are included again per reply within the existing 30 MiB/20-photo limits
Use bounded text excerpts and the most recent 12 messages
Only exact supplied source IDs and source HTTPS URLs may be returned
A stable successful request_id returns the saved reply without another provider call
